abstract: A 40-year-old man visited our hospital in August, 2007 with the complaint of gait disturbance. Six years ago he had had right high orchiectomy for treatment of stage I seminoma at another hospital. The magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) examination showed a small tumor and compression fracture in the eighth thoracic vertebrae. Emergency spinal decompression with bone biopsy was done. The pathological diagnosis of the bone was metastasis of seminoma. He was treated with 3 courses of BEP (bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin) therapy and external beam radiotherapy (36 Gy) was performed. His symptom of gait disturbance disappeared gradually, and was evaluated to be in complete remission. He has been alive with no evidence of recurrence for 3 years.
abstract_ja: 40歳男性が2007年8月に歩行障害を主訴に当院を受診した。6年前、他院で病期Iのセミノーマに対し右側高位精巣摘除術を受けていた。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で第8胸椎に小腫瘤と圧迫骨折を認めた。緊急で脊髄減圧術と骨生検を施行した。病理組織学的検査で骨病変はセミノーマの転移と診断された。BEP療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)を3コース施行し、外部照射放射線療法(36 Gy)を行った。歩行障害は徐々に消失し、完全寛解と評価された。3年間再発の証拠なく生存している。
